readout_other: Resting-state fMRI right-thalamus seed connectivity; DTI probabilistic tractography
direction_notes: One sonication increased right-thalamus to left-thalamus connectivity; three sonications decreased connectivity with right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex.
safety_notes: Transient scalp pressure discomfort in most participants; one vasovagal-type episode 15 min after 3-LIFU; no thermal sensations or pain syndromes.

exposures.label: 1-LIFU and 3-LIFU to right thalamo-prefrontal white matter tracts

target.label: individually modeled right thalamo-prefrontal white matter tracts

timing.protocol_description: Theta-burst pattern of 400 20-ms pulses delivered every 180 ms, 10% duty cycle, 80 s total. 1-LIFU = one epoch; 3-LIFU = three consecutive epochs separated by two 30-s intervals.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Methods: In this preregistered, double-blind, randomized study, 35 healthy adults underwent LIFU targeting (80 s, 10% duty cycle, estimated ISPPA 2.26 W/cm<sup>2</sup>, 0.5 MHz, in a θ-burst pattern) of individually modeled right thalamo-prefrontal white matter tracts under two dose conditions: one and three consecutive sonications. Dose-dependent changes in resting-state functional connectivity were examined during a 30-minute poststimulation period in 31 participants.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: y design. Each participant completed three visits: a baseline visit (V0) without LIFU stimulation and two LIFU visits (Visits 1 and 2) in randomized order.
